scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter api run start:dev" "pnpm --filter client run dev"
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter api run lint && pnpm --filter client run lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter api run lint:fix && pnpm --filter client run lint:fix
scripts.format: pnpm --filter api run format:check && pnpm --filter client run check
scripts.format:fix: pnpm --filter api run format && pnpm --filter client run format:fix
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter api run build && pnpm --filter client run build
scripts.build:api: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter api run build
scripts.build:client: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter client run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter api run typecheck && pnpm --filter client run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:api: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter api run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:client: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter client run typecheck
